Our Medical Billing Process to Prevent Revenue Loss and Minimize A/R Aging Cycles

Our billing services flowchart helps you take a progressive approach toward maintaining efficient revenue cycle management, combating claim denials, and enhancing practice revenue.

  1. 1

    Patient Registration

    • Accurate patient data collection: demographics, medical history, and insurance details
    • Verification of patient details before every encounter
  2. 2

    Prior Authorization and Eligibility Verification

    • Prior authorization obtained from the insurance company before services are rendered
    • Efficient eligibility checks to prevent denials at the source
  3. 3

    Medical Coding

    • Absolute error-free standardized coding by AAPC-certified coders
    • Identification of errors and immediate rectification before claim submission
  4. 4

    Charge Entry

    • Charges posted promptly to patient accounts to prevent surprise bills
    • Efficient charge posting to expedite reimbursements and reduce delays
  5. 5

    Claims Submission

    • Claims submitted electronically within 24 hours of encounter lock
    • Fast, clean claim submissions with full accuracy and industry-standard protocols
  6. 6

    Denial Management

    • Constant follow-up on the status of all submitted claims
    • Old claims, rejections, denials, and delays all addressed within 48 hours
    • A/R aging cycles minimized to improve collections across all payers
  7. 7

    Payment Posting

    • Payments posted daily after successful claims processing: co-pays, deductibles, and insurance payments
    • Financial transparency ensured with full reconciliation and variance flagging
  8. 8

    Reporting via PMEX Portal

    • Real-time billing data updated by your billing team, visible anytime via the PMEX Portal
    • Tracks collections, denials, A/R aging, and payer performance with full financial transparency
